title: A2CN Acceptance
description: The Section 7.4 act that accepts a specific offer. It carries no terms: the offer it accepts was already checked, and accepted_protocol_act_hash binds the acceptance to that offer's signed protocol act. acceptance_signature covers the signed act object of Section 7.3.1 — the common header plus this act's payload, accepted_offer_id and accepted_protocol_act_hash — and NOT the whole message: message_id, in_reply_to and sender_agent_id are outside the signed scope. The message object stays open so vendor fields pass through.

in_reply_to.description: The message_id of the offer or counteroffer being accepted (Section 7.4).

accepted_offer_id.description: The message_id of the accepted offer or counteroffer.

accepted_protocol_act_hash.description: MUST equal the protocol_act_hash of the accepted offer (Section 7.4).

sender_verification_method.description: DID URL of the verification method used to sign this message (Section 7.4).

timestamp.description: Inside the signed scope (Section 7.3.1): the acceptance's own timestamp, not the offer's.

protocol_version.description: Not carried on the wire by this implementation. A verifier rebuilding the signed act uses its own wire version unless the act states one (Section 7.3.1).

acceptance_signature.description: Attached JWS Compact Serialization over base64url(ASCII(hash)) of the Section 7.3.1 signed act object. Not a JWT claim set.
